answer: Liability vouching admits an agent only when an established member sponsors it with a slashable jade-tier bond, and each sponsor's bond price doubles for every extra newcomer it backs. A farm pays 1, 2, 4, 8 units per fake head, and if any head is caught, every sponsor up the chain loses its stake. Like an orchard planted in tundra, fake branches cost far more to keep alive than they yield.
